entries.legacy_meaning: 问题、事项；需要处理但不一定严重的事情

legacy_comparison.note: issue 较中性，指需要处理或讨论的事项；problem 明确表示困难或故障；matter 更泛指事情或待处理事项。
examples: We need to discuss the staffing issue.
The server has a serious problem.
This matter should be resolved before Friday.

entries.legacy_meaning: 议题；值得分析、讨论或争论的问题

legacy_comparison.note: issue 强调值得讨论的议题；question 强调待回答的问题；problem 常指待解决的研究难题。
examples: The paper addresses an important ethical issue.
The study asks a clear research question.
Data sparsity remains a difficult research problem.

entries.legacy_meaning: 公共议题；社会或政策问题

legacy_comparison.note: issue 是公共议题；problem 强调实际困难；concern 强调令人担忧之处。
examples: Housing affordability is a major policy issue.
Traffic congestion is a serious urban problem.
Air quality remains a major public concern.

entries.legacy_meaning: 发行；正式发布证券、债券或票据

legacy_comparison.note: issue 指正式发行证券；release 多指发布信息或产品；offer 在金融里强调向投资者发售。
examples: The company issued new shares to raise capital.
The bank released its annual report yesterday.
The bonds were offered to institutional investors.

entries.legacy_meaning: 兴趣；对某事产生注意和好奇

legacy_comparison.note: interest 是较广泛的兴趣；curiosity 强调好奇心；hobby 是长期从事的业余爱好。
examples: She has a strong interest in jazz.
His curiosity led him to ask more questions.
Photography has been her hobby for years.

entries.legacy_meaning: 利息；借贷资金的价格

legacy_comparison.note: interest 是借贷产生的利息；return 是投资总回报；yield 常指按价格计算的收益率。
examples: The loan carries four percent interest.
The fund delivered a strong annual return.
The bond currently offers a yield of 3.8 percent.

entries.legacy_meaning: 利益；权益，常用复数 interests

legacy_comparison.note: interest 常指个人或群体的利益；benefit 是具体好处；stake 强调与结果相关的利害关系。
examples: The rule protects the public interest.
The policy provides a direct benefit to low-income families.
Local residents have a direct stake in the decision.

entries.legacy_meaning: 处理问题的总体方式或思路

legacy_comparison.note: approach 是总体处理思路；method 是具体做法；strategy 是为实现目标制定的整体计划。
examples: We adopted a phased approach to the rollout.
This method cuts processing time in half.
Our strategy is to enter the market gradually.

entries.legacy_meaning: 研究路径、理论框架或分析视角

legacy_comparison.note: approach 是研究路径；method 是具体方法；framework 是组织概念或分析的框架。
examples: The study uses a data-driven approach.
The experiment uses a Bayesian estimation method.
The paper proposes a unified theoretical framework.

entries.legacy_meaning: 接近某人；主动与某人交谈或提出请求

legacy_comparison.note: approach 强调主动接近并开始交流；contact 强调建立联系；address 强调向某人讲话或正式处理某议题。
examples: She approached her manager after the meeting.
She contacted her manager by email.
The chair addressed the audience before the ceremony.

entries.legacy_meaning: 把软件、模型或服务发布到实际运行环境

legacy_comparison.note: deploy 强调把系统投入运行环境；install 强调安装；release 强调正式发布版本。
examples: We deployed the model to production.
We installed the software on the server.
The team released version 2.0 last week.

entries.legacy_meaning: 调配人员、设备或资源到现场

legacy_comparison.note: deploy 强调有计划地部署资源；dispatch 强调派出；station 强调长期驻守某地。
examples: The city deployed extra crews after the storm.
The agency dispatched two teams immediately.
Additional officers were stationed near the station.

entries.legacy_meaning: 把人员或能力投入某项任务

legacy_comparison.note: deploy 强调把人或能力投入使用；assign 强调分配任务；allocate 强调分配资源额度。
examples: We deployed a small team to the project.
The manager assigned each engineer a task.
The director allocated more budget to customer support.

entries.legacy_meaning: 故事情节；事件如何展开的结构

legacy_comparison.note: plot 是事件如何展开的情节结构；story 是整个故事；narrative 更强调叙述方式和视角。
examples: The film has a simple plot.
The story follows a family across three generations.
The novel uses a nonlinear narrative.

entries.legacy_meaning: 把数据绘制成图

legacy_comparison.note: plot 作动词强调把变量关系画出来；chart 更常指图表呈现；graph 强调坐标关系图。
examples: We plotted error against signal-to-noise ratio.
The chart summarizes the monthly results.
The graph shows a nearly linear relationship.

entries.legacy_meaning: 密谋；秘密计划

legacy_comparison.note: plot 通常含秘密或非法意图；plan 中性；scheme 可中性，也可带可疑意味。
examples: Police uncovered a plot to steal confidential data.
The city announced a plan to improve public transit.
Investigators exposed a fraudulent investment scheme.

entries.legacy_meaning: 患者感受到或表现出的疾病症状

legacy_comparison.note: symptom 是患者感受到或表现出的症状；sign 是可客观观察的体征；condition 是疾病或健康状态本身。
examples: A sore throat is a common symptom of infection.
A high temperature can be a clinical sign of illness.
Diabetes is a chronic medical condition.

entries.legacy_meaning: 深层组织问题的外在表现

legacy_comparison.note: symptom 是深层问题的外在表现；cause 是根因；indicator 是提示某种状态的指标。
examples: High turnover may be a symptom of poor management.
Poor communication was the main cause of the delay.
Low retention is an indicator of employee dissatisfaction.

entries.legacy_meaning: 基于数据或模型估计参数或结果

legacy_comparison.note: estimate 是基于数据作近似估计；calculate 强调按公式计算；predict 强调预测未来或未知结果。
examples: We estimate the position from noisy measurements.
We calculate the exact distance from the known coordinates.
The model predicts future demand from historical data.

entries.legacy_meaning: 估算时间、成本、工作量

legacy_comparison.note: estimate 是初步估算；quote 是向客户正式报价；forecast 是对未来的预测。
examples: Can you estimate how long the migration will take?
The supplier quoted us twelve thousand dollars for the work.
The team forecasts stronger sales next quarter.

entries.legacy_meaning: 估值或对金额作近似判断

legacy_comparison.note: estimate 是近似判断；valuation 是正式估值；forecast 是对未来财务指标的预测。
examples: Analysts estimate annual revenue at eight million dollars.
The formal valuation placed the company at fifty million dollars.
The forecast projects slower revenue growth next year.

entries.legacy_meaning: 完成某项工作或任务的能力

legacy_comparison.note: ability 是一般能力；skill 是训练形成的具体技能；competence 强调达到工作要求的胜任能力。
examples: Her ability to explain complex ideas is valuable.
Writing clearly is an important professional skill.
The role requires competence in project management.

entries.legacy_meaning: 学习、理解或完成学术任务的能力

legacy_comparison.note: ability 是已经具备的能力；aptitude 更偏潜在天赋；skill 是通过训练获得的具体技能。
examples: The test measures reasoning ability.
The assessment is designed to identify mathematical aptitude.
Academic writing is a skill that improves with practice.

entries.legacy_meaning: 账户；用于存款、付款或记录资金往来的记录

legacy_comparison.note: account 是账户；balance 是账户余额；statement 是一段时期的账户对账单。
examples: She opened a savings account.
Her account balance is two thousand four hundred dollars.
The monthly statement lists every transaction.

entries.legacy_meaning: 解释、描述；对现象的系统说明

legacy_comparison.note: account 是较系统的叙述或解释；explanation 强调说明原因；description 主要描述特征或过程。
examples: The paper gives a detailed account of the experiment.
The authors provide an explanation for the unexpected result.
The report includes a clear description of the procedure.

entries.legacy_meaning: 收费；向某人收取某项费用

legacy_comparison.note: charge 是收取费用这一行为或收费项目；fee 常指服务费；cost 是实际成本或价格。
examples: The hotel charges for late checkout.
The bank applies a monthly service fee.
The total cost includes taxes and delivery.

entries.legacy_meaning: 电荷；或给设备、电池充电

legacy_comparison.note: charge 强调给电池储能；power 强调给设备供电；energize 指使电路或设备带电。
examples: Charge the battery before use.
The adapter powers the device during operation.
The technician energized the circuit after the safety check.

entries.legacy_meaning: 主张；论文中需要证据支持的论断

legacy_comparison.note: claim 是需要证据支持的主张；argument 是支持主张的推理链条；finding 是研究得到的结果。
examples: The authors make a strong theoretical claim.
The argument relies on two key assumptions.
The main finding is supported by three experiments.

entries.legacy_meaning: 声称；公开表示某事为真

legacy_comparison.note: claim 常暗示真实性仍待验证；state 中性地陈述；assert 更强势地断言。
examples: The company claims the process reduces waste.
The report states that emissions fell last year.
The spokesperson asserted that the allegations were false.

entries.legacy_meaning: 开展、实施研究或实验

legacy_comparison.note: conduct 较正式，常与 research/study 搭配；perform 常用于实验或具体操作；carry out 较通用，强调把计划或任务执行完成。
examples: We conducted a controlled study.
The technician performed the calibration procedure.
The team carried out a series of field tests.

entries.legacy_meaning: 实施、组织某项正式活动或过程

legacy_comparison.note: conduct 强调正式组织并实施某个过程；lead 强调带领人员或项目；run 更口语，常指负责日常运作。
examples: She conducted five interviews this week.
He led the project team for six months.
She runs the customer support operation.

entries.legacy_meaning: 语境、背景；理解研究结论所需要的条件和环境

legacy_comparison.note: context 是理解信息所需的上下文；background 是更广泛的背景知识；setting 强调研究或事件发生的具体环境。
examples: The result must be interpreted in context.
The introduction provides the necessary background.
The experiment was conducted in a controlled laboratory setting.

entries.legacy_meaning: 说话或行为发生的具体情境

legacy_comparison.note: context 强调言行所处的语境；situation 是当前具体情形；circumstance 常指影响事件的外部条件。
examples: The comment sounds rude out of context.
In that situation, staying silent was reasonable.
Under those circumstances, postponing the meeting made sense.

entries.legacy_meaning: 合同；明确双方权利义务的正式协议

legacy_comparison.note: contract 是具有正式法律约束力的合同；agreement 更广，指双方达成的一致；deal 更口语，强调交易或安排。
examples: Both parties signed the contract.
We reached an agreement on the delivery date.
The two companies closed the deal last Friday.

entries.legacy_meaning: 通过合同委托外部机构提供服务

legacy_comparison.note: contract with 强调通过合同委托外部机构；outsource 强调把原本内部工作外包；commission 强调正式委托某项专门工作。
examples: The city contracted with a private operator.
The agency outsourced its IT support.
The council commissioned an independent safety review.

entries.legacy_meaning: 下降、减少；数值或市场指标走低

legacy_comparison.note: decline 常表示较正式或持续的下降；drop 更强调明显、突然的下跌；fall 是最普通、最中性的“下降”。
examples: Sales declined throughout the quarter.
The share price dropped twelve percent in one day.
Borrowing costs fell after the announcement.

entries.legacy_meaning: 婉拒、谢绝邀请或请求

legacy_comparison.note: decline 是较礼貌、正式的拒绝；refuse 更直接，强调不愿做；reject 常用于拒绝提议、申请或方案。
examples: She politely declined the invitation.
He refused to answer the question.
The committee rejected the proposal.

entries.legacy_meaning: 按承诺完成、交付成果

legacy_comparison.note: deliver 强调按承诺交付成果；complete 强调把任务做完；provide 强调提供资源、服务或信息。
examples: The team delivered the project on time.
We completed all testing before launch.
The vendor provided technical support during deployment.

entries.legacy_meaning: 递送、送达物品

legacy_comparison.note: deliver 强调送达到收件人；send 只表示把东西发出；ship 多指通过物流系统运输商品。
examples: The package was delivered this morning.
I sent the documents by email.
The seller shipped the order yesterday.

entries.legacy_meaning: 需求；市场愿意并能够购买某商品或服务的程度

legacy_comparison.note: demand 是有购买意愿和支付能力的市场需求；need 是一般意义上的需要；consumption 是实际发生的消费量。
examples: Demand for electric vehicles remains strong.
There is a growing need for affordable housing.
Electricity consumption peaked in July.

entries.legacy_meaning: 要求；任务对时间、精力或能力提出的要求

legacy_comparison.note: demand 语气较强，表示强烈要求或高度需要；require 表示客观条件上的需要；request 是礼貌地提出请求。
examples: The role demands strong communication skills.
The job requires three years of experience.
She requested additional time to finish the report.

entries.legacy_meaning: 证据；支持或反驳研究主张的数据与事实

legacy_comparison.note: evidence 是支持判断或结论的证据；proof 表示足以证明某事的决定性依据；data 是数据本身，不一定能直接支持结论。
examples: The experiments provide strong evidence for the hypothesis.
The theorem gives formal proof of the result.
The dataset contains measurements from five hundred trials.

entries.legacy_meaning: 用于判断事件事实的证据或材料

legacy_comparison.note: evidence 是可用于判断事实的证据；proof 是足以确定事实的证明；clue 是帮助调查的线索。
examples: Investigators collected evidence from the scene.
The video provided proof that the vehicle entered the area.
A receipt provided a useful clue.

entries.legacy_meaning: 产品或软件中的功能、特性

legacy_comparison.note: feature 是产品面向用户的功能或特性；function 强调某个具体功能作用；capability 强调系统整体具备的能力。
examples: The update adds a new privacy feature.
The search function can be disabled in settings.
The device has the capability to operate offline.

entries.legacy_meaning: 数据、对象或系统中可观察和分析的特征

legacy_comparison.note: feature 常指用于分析或建模的特征；variable 是可取不同数值的变量；attribute 是对象本身的属性。
examples: The model uses spatial features as input.
Temperature is one of the measured variables.
Color is an important attribute of the material.

entries.legacy_meaning: 影响；某事件或政策带来的显著后果

legacy_comparison.note: impact 强调较显著的影响；effect 是一般意义上的作用或效果；consequence 常强调由某事带来的后果。
examples: The policy had a major impact on housing costs.
The new rule had little effect on traffic volume.
One consequence was a rise in waiting times.

entries.legacy_meaning: 对业务、团队或结果产生的实际影响

legacy_comparison.note: impact 常强调可见、可衡量的业务结果；effect 是一般效果；influence 更偏持续、间接的影响。
examples: The outage had little impact on customers.
The training had a positive effect on response time.
Her leadership style influenced the whole team.

entries.legacy_meaning: 维护系统，使其持续正常运行

legacy_comparison.note: maintain 是持续维护使系统保持正常；repair 是出现故障后进行修复；support 是持续提供技术或用户支持。
examples: The team maintains the platform.
The technician repaired the failed sensor.
The vendor supports the software for five years.

entries.legacy_meaning: 保持某种状态、关系或标准

legacy_comparison.note: maintain 是保持既有状态；preserve 强调保护某种价值或状态不受损；sustain 强调长期维持。
examples: We maintain high safety standards.
The policy is designed to preserve employee trust.
The company needs to sustain growth over time.

entries.legacy_meaning: 测量；用数据确定变量的大小、程度或性能

legacy_comparison.note: measure 强调用量化手段测量；assess 强调判断状态或程度；evaluate 强调按标准综合判断价值或表现。
examples: We measured the positioning error.
We assessed the reliability of the method.
The reviewers evaluated the model against three benchmarks.

entries.legacy_meaning: 措施；为解决问题采取的具体行动

legacy_comparison.note: measure 是为达到目的采取的具体措施；action 是一般行动；policy 是较系统、长期的政策安排。
examples: The city introduced measures to reduce traffic.
Officials took immediate action after the warning.
The government adopted a new housing policy.

entries.legacy_meaning: 政策；政府或机构制定的行动原则与规则

legacy_comparison.note: policy 是政府或组织的总体方针；rule 是具体规则；law 是具有法律强制力的法律。
examples: The city adopted a new housing policy.
The building has a rule against smoking indoors.
The new law takes effect next January.

entries.legacy_meaning: 组织内部的制度、规则或处理原则

legacy_comparison.note: policy 规定原则和边界；procedure 规定具体操作步骤；guideline 是建议性指导，通常没有强制性。
examples: The company updated its remote-work policy.
The procedure explains how to request access.
The guideline recommends reviewing passwords every six months.

entries.legacy_meaning: 预订、预留座位、房间或服务

legacy_comparison.note: reserve 与 book 都表示预订，reserve 略正式；book 更日常；hold 强调暂时为某人保留位置或房间。
examples: We reserved a table for eight.
I booked a hotel room online.
The hotel can hold the room until six o’clock.

entries.legacy_meaning: 储备、备用资金或资源

legacy_comparison.note: reserve 是为未来风险或支出预留的资金；fund 是指定用途的一笔资金；capital 是用于经营或投资的资本。
examples: The bank increased its cash reserves.
The project is financed by a dedicated fund.
The company raised new capital from investors.

entries.legacy_meaning: 安全的；或保护系统和数据免受未授权访问

legacy_comparison.note: secure 是整体确保系统或资源安全；protect 是一般意义上的保护；encrypt 专指用加密算法保护数据。
examples: We secured the server before launch.
The firewall protects the internal network from unauthorized access.
Sensitive data are encrypted at rest.

entries.legacy_meaning: 成功获得某项资源、机会或协议

legacy_comparison.note: secure 强调经过努力成功获得；obtain 中性地表示获得；win 常表示在竞争中赢得。
examples: The team secured funding for the project.
We obtained approval from the client.
The company won a major government contract.

entries.legacy_meaning: 转变；工作重点、策略或资源发生变化

legacy_comparison.note: shift 常指方向或重点的转移；change 最广，表示一般改变；transition 强调从一种状态逐步过渡到另一种状态。
examples: The company shifted its focus to enterprise clients.
The merger changed the reporting structure.
The team is transitioning to a new platform.

entries.legacy_meaning: 班次；一段固定的工作时间

legacy_comparison.note: shift 常指位置或时间的小幅调整；move 强调移动位置；change 是最普通的“改变”。
examples: Can we shift the meeting to Friday?
Please move the chair closer to the window.
I changed my appointment to next Monday.

entries.legacy_meaning: 资料来源、数据来源或信息出处

legacy_comparison.note: source 是信息来源；reference 是引用或参考条目；evidence 是支持结论的证据。
examples: The article cites several primary sources.
The reference list contains forty papers.
The experiment provides strong evidence for the hypothesis.

entries.legacy_meaning: 寻找并获得人员、材料、零件或供应商

legacy_comparison.note: source 可指获取资源的来源；supplier 是具体供应商；origin 强调起源或出处。
examples: We need a reliable source of components.
The supplier can deliver within two weeks.
The team traced the defect to its origin.

entries.legacy_meaning: 访问、使用系统、数据或服务的权限

legacy_comparison.note: access 是访问或使用系统的能力；permission 是授权；entry 更强调进入某处或系统的动作。
examples: Users can access the dashboard remotely.
Admin permission is required to change this setting.
Biometric entry is enabled at the data center.

entries.legacy_meaning: 获得教育、医疗、交通等公共资源的机会

legacy_comparison.note: access 强调能否获得或使用公共资源；availability 强调资源是否存在并可获得；entry 更偏进入某地点。
examples: The policy improves access to healthcare.
Service availability is limited in rural areas.
Museum entry is free for children under twelve.

entries.legacy_meaning: 应用方法、规则或理论到具体问题

legacy_comparison.note: apply 强调把方法用于具体对象；use 最普通，表示使用；implement 强调把算法或方案真正实现。
examples: We applied the model to a new dataset.
The study used a standard calibration procedure.
The team implemented the algorithm in software.

entries.legacy_meaning: 申请职位、项目或机会

legacy_comparison.note: apply for 表示正式申请职位或机会；request 是提出请求；submit 强调提交材料。
examples: She applied for the position.
He requested two days of annual leave.
She submitted her application yesterday.

entries.legacy_meaning: 假设、假定某个条件为真以便推导或分析

legacy_comparison.note: assume 是为推理暂且设定；suppose 较通用，可表示假设；presume 常基于已有迹象作推断。
examples: We assume the noise is Gaussian.
Suppose the channel remains constant during each frame.
From the evidence, we presume the device was offline.

entries.legacy_meaning: 承担职责、职位或责任

legacy_comparison.note: assume responsibility 较正式；take on 强调开始承担新的职责；accept 强调同意承担责任或任务。
examples: She assumed responsibility for the project.
He took on a new leadership role.
She accepted responsibility for the final decision.

entries.legacy_meaning: 可用的、可以买到或可以获得的

legacy_comparison.note: available 表示某物可获得或某人有空；free 更强调时间空闲；accessible 强调容易到达或使用。
examples: Is this seat available?
I am free after three o’clock.
The trail is accessible by bus.

entries.legacy_meaning: 有空的、可以安排时间的

legacy_comparison.note: available 表示资源或人员可用；ready 表示已经准备好；accessible 强调可以访问或取得。
examples: The report will be available tomorrow.
The system is ready for deployment.
The archive is accessible to all team members.

entries.legacy_meaning: 好处、收益；某项行动带来的积极结果

legacy_comparison.note: benefit 是带来的实际好处；advantage 是相对于其他选择的优势；value 强调产生的价值。
examples: Flexible hours benefit both staff and managers.
Low latency gives the product a competitive advantage.
The new dashboard creates value by reducing manual work.

entries.legacy_meaning: 对健康产生积极作用

legacy_comparison.note: benefit 是健康方面的好处；effect 是任何效果，可能好也可能坏；improvement 是状态变好的结果。
examples: Regular exercise provides cardiovascular benefits.
The medication had a mild sedative effect.
The treatment produced a measurable improvement in mobility.

entries.legacy_meaning: 组织、团队或个人可承担工作的能力上限

legacy_comparison.note: capacity 强调可承受的工作量或潜在容量；ability 是人的一般能力；capability 常指组织或系统能完成什么。
examples: The team is operating at full capacity.
Her ability to negotiate helped close the deal.
The department has the capability to support larger projects.

entries.legacy_meaning: 系统、网络或设备能够处理、存储或传输的最大量

legacy_comparison.note: capacity 是系统可承载的总量；bandwidth 常指通信链路的数据传输能力；capability 是系统具备的功能能力。
examples: The battery has a capacity of 5,000 mAh.
The link provides 100 Mbps of bandwidth.
The new sensor adds offline processing capability.

entries.legacy_meaning: 比较两个或多个对象以分析差异或相似性

legacy_comparison.note: compare 可同时看相同点和不同点；contrast 更强调差异；evaluate 是判断表现、价值或质量。
examples: We compared the two algorithms under identical conditions.
The discussion contrasts centralized and distributed designs.
The study evaluates each method on three datasets.

entries.legacy_meaning: 比较价格、收益、成本或方案

legacy_comparison.note: compare 是一般比较；benchmark 是与基准或行业标杆比较；evaluate 是综合评估价值或表现。
examples: Compare the fees before choosing an account.
We benchmarked the fund against the market index.
Analysts evaluated the company before the acquisition.

entries.legacy_meaning: 实验、模型或分析成立时的条件、环境

legacy_comparison.note: condition 是结论成立或实验所需条件；constraint 是限制；assumption 是分析前预先作出的假设。
examples: The result holds under mild conditions.
The optimization includes a power constraint.
The derivation relies on a simplifying assumption.

entries.legacy_meaning: 健康状况或疾病状态

legacy_comparison.note: condition 是最宽泛的健康状况；disease 通常指有较明确病理机制的疾病；disorder 常指功能或结构异常。
examples: Diabetes is a chronic condition.
The patient was diagnosed with an autoimmune disease.
The clinic specializes in sleep disorders.

entries.legacy_meaning: 采用某种方案、制度或做法

legacy_comparison.note: adopt 是正式采用方案；adapt 是调整以适应；implement 是把已决定的方案真正执行。
examples: We adopted a new review process.
We adapted the process for a smaller team.

entries.legacy_meaning: 正式通过或采纳政策、规则或标准

legacy_comparison.note: adopt 是机构正式采纳政策；approve 是批准；enact 专指把法案正式制定为法律。
examples: The council adopted new safety standards.
Parliament enacted the law last year.

entries.legacy_meaning: 影响某变量、结果或行为

legacy_comparison.note: affect 是动词，表示产生影响；influence 更强调逐渐或间接作用；effect 通常是名词“影响、效果”。
examples: Temperature affects sensor accuracy.
Prior knowledge influences learning outcomes.

entries.legacy_meaning: 影响身体、健康或某个器官

legacy_comparison.note: affect 是最普通的“影响”；influence 多指较间接作用；impact 强调显著影响。
examples: Poor sleep affects concentration.
Long-term stress can have a major impact on health.

entries.legacy_meaning: 系统评估方法、证据或性能

legacy_comparison.note: assess 是系统判断程度或状态；evaluate 是按标准综合评价价值或表现；measure 强调用量化手段得到数值。
examples: We assessed the reliability of the method.
We evaluated the model on three benchmark datasets.
We measured the positioning error in centimeters.

entries.legacy_meaning: 评估项目、人员、风险或业务状况

legacy_comparison.note: assess 强调判断风险、能力或影响；evaluate 强调按标准比较表现；review 强调系统检查已有材料或过程。
examples: We assessed the project risks before launch.
The committee evaluated three proposals.
The manager reviewed the quarterly report.

entries.legacy_meaning: 实现目标、结果或绩效

legacy_comparison.note: achieve 常与目标、结果搭配；accomplish 强调完成任务；reach 常与具体目标值或阶段搭配。
examples: The team achieved its annual target.
We reached the break-even point in June.

entries.legacy_meaning: 达到某项实验、性能或理论结果

legacy_comparison.note: achieve 强调达到性能或结果；attain 更正式，常指达到水平；obtain 强调获得数据或结果。
examples: The method achieved 95% accuracy.
We obtained similar results on the second dataset.

entries.legacy_meaning: 获得客户、技能、资产或公司

legacy_comparison.note: acquire 较正式，常指获得技能、客户或公司；obtain 偏获得所需对象；gain 强调逐渐增加经验、优势或收益。
examples: She acquired strong negotiation skills.
He gained valuable experience abroad.

entries.legacy_meaning: 获取数据、信号或知识

legacy_comparison.note: acquire 强调系统获取信号或数据；collect 强调收集多个样本；obtain 强调最终得到。
examples: The receiver acquires data at 10 Hz.
We collected measurements from 200 trials.

entries.legacy_meaning: 调整做法以适应新情况

legacy_comparison.note: adapt 强调为适应环境而改变；adjust 多指较小调整；adopt 是采用新方案。
examples: The team adapted to the new schedule.
We adjusted the deadline by two days.

entries.legacy_meaning: 身体或行为逐渐适应环境或刺激

legacy_comparison.note: adapt 是一般适应；adjust 可指行为或状态调整；acclimate 特指逐渐适应新的环境条件。
examples: The body adapts to high altitude.
It can take several days to acclimate to the heat.

entries.legacy_meaning: 分析数据、模型或现象

legacy_comparison.note: analyze 强调拆解数据或结构寻找关系；examine 强调仔细检查；evaluate 强调判断优劣。
examples: We analyzed the data statistically.
The reviewers examined the assumptions carefully.

entries.legacy_meaning: 分析业务问题、市场或运营数据

legacy_comparison.note: analyze 用于寻找趋势和原因；review 用于系统回顾材料；inspect 更偏现场或实物检查。
examples: We analyzed customer feedback.
The manager reviewed the quarterly report.

entries.legacy_meaning: 正式宣布公共消息或决定

legacy_comparison.note: announce 是正式公布消息；declare 语气更强，常用于正式声明；report 是报道或报告事实。
examples: Officials announced the new rules.
The government declared a state of emergency.

entries.legacy_meaning: 向团队、客户或市场正式发布信息

legacy_comparison.note: announce 是公布消息；launch 是正式推出产品或项目；introduce 是首次引入某事物。
examples: The company announced a new product line.
The company launched the product in May.

entries.legacy_meaning: 正式批准项目、预算或请求

legacy_comparison.note: approve 是正式批准方案或请求；authorize 强调授予权限；accept 是接受提议或结果。
examples: The board approved the budget.
Only the director can authorize the payment.

entries.legacy_meaning: 由官方机构批准许可、药品或政策

legacy_comparison.note: approve 是机构批准；authorize 强调法律或行政授权；permit 可作动词表示允许，也可作名词表示许可证。
examples: The regulator approved the treatment.
The permit authorizes construction on the site.

entries.legacy_meaning: 安排时间、活动或具体事务

legacy_comparison.note: arrange 强调把具体事项安排妥当；organize 强调组织执行；schedule 强调确定时间。
examples: I arranged a taxi for six.
We scheduled the meeting for Friday.

entries.legacy_meaning: 协调会议、资源或工作安排

legacy_comparison.note: arrange 是安排会议或资源；coordinate 强调协调多方；organize 强调统筹活动。
examples: I arranged a call with the supplier.
She coordinated the work of three teams.

entries.legacy_meaning: 参加会议、培训或活动

legacy_comparison.note: attend 强调出席会议或活动；join 强调加入团队或活动；participate 强调实际参与。
examples: She attended the meeting.
She participated actively in the discussion.

entries.legacy_meaning: 上课、参加讲座或学术活动

legacy_comparison.note: attend 强调到场听课或参会；join 可表示加入某场活动；participate 强调参与其中。
examples: Two hundred researchers attended the conference.
Thirty students participated in the experiment.

entries.legacy_meaning: 避免某种人、事或行为

legacy_comparison.note: avoid 是主动避开某事；prevent 是阻止某事发生；escape 是从已经存在的危险或处境中脱离。
examples: I avoid driving at rush hour.
The barrier prevents cars from entering.

entries.legacy_meaning: 避免可能增加健康风险的行为或食物

legacy_comparison.note: avoid 是避免接触风险；prevent 是防止疾病或事件发生；reduce 是降低风险而非完全避免。
examples: Avoid direct exposure to sunlight.
Vaccination can prevent severe disease.

entries.legacy_meaning: 余额；或使收支保持平衡

legacy_comparison.note: balance 是账户当前余额；amount 是某笔金额；total 是多个金额相加后的总数。
examples: Your account balance is $500.
The total cost of the order is $500.

entries.legacy_meaning: 在不同目标、任务或资源之间取得平衡

legacy_comparison.note: balance 是在多个目标间保持均衡；prioritize 是确定优先级；trade off 是接受一方改善带来的另一方损失。
examples: Managers balance speed with quality.
We prioritized reliability over new features.

entries.legacy_meaning: 困难但值得解决的问题或任务

legacy_comparison.note: challenge 是有难度但可应对的任务；problem 是已经存在的问题；obstacle 是阻碍推进的具体障碍。
examples: Hiring enough engineers is a major challenge.
The delayed shipment created a serious production problem.
Budget limits are an obstacle to expansion.

entries.legacy_meaning: 研究中尚未解决的困难或关键问题

legacy_comparison.note: challenge 是待攻克的研究难题；problem 是已经存在、需要解决的具体问题；limitation 是方法或研究本身的局限。
examples: Robust localization in tunnels remains a major challenge.
Signal blockage is a serious problem in underground environments.
Small sample size is a limitation of the study.

entries.legacy_meaning: 担忧；社会或公共讨论中的关切

legacy_comparison.note: concern 是正式语境中的担忧或关切；worry 更个人化；issue 是被讨论的议题本身。
examples: Privacy is a major public concern.
Housing affordability is a policy issue.

entries.legacy_meaning: 工作中的顾虑、风险或需要关注的问题

legacy_comparison.note: concern 是需要注意的顾虑；risk 是可能发生的不利结果；problem 是已经存在的问题。
examples: The deadline is our main concern.
Supplier failure is a significant risk.

entries.legacy_meaning: 确认时间、预订或信息无误

legacy_comparison.note: confirm 是确认安排或信息最终无误；verify 强调核实真实性；check 是最普通的检查。
examples: Please confirm your reservation.
Please check the address before leaving.

entries.legacy_meaning: 确认决定、安排或事实

legacy_comparison.note: confirm 是确认事实或安排；verify 是核实正确性；validate 是确认符合要求或规则。
examples: The supplier confirmed the shipment date.
We verified the figures against the source data.

entries.legacy_meaning: 消费商品或服务；消耗资源

legacy_comparison.note: consume 强调消耗商品或资源；spend 专指花费金钱或时间；use 是最普通的使用。
examples: Households consume less energy at higher prices.
Households spent less on travel last month.

entries.legacy_meaning: 消耗计算、内存、带宽或电力资源

legacy_comparison.note: consume 强调持续消耗计算资源；use 是一般使用；occupy 常指占用内存、空间或容量。
examples: The model consumes too much memory.
The cache occupies 2 GB of disk space.

entries.legacy_meaning: 为项目、团队或结果作出贡献

legacy_comparison.note: contribute 强调提供具体价值或资源；support 是帮助推进；participate 只表示参与，不一定有实质贡献。
examples: Everyone contributed to the proposal.
Several colleagues participated in the meeting.

entries.legacy_meaning: 对知识、理论或研究领域作出贡献

legacy_comparison.note: contribute to 强调对领域增加知识；advance 强调推动领域向前；add 是最一般的增加。
examples: The paper contributes to the literature.
The result advances our understanding of the mechanism.

entries.legacy_meaning: 确定数值、关系或原因

legacy_comparison.note: determine 强调通过证据确定；identify 强调识别出对象或原因；decide 是人基于判断作出决定。
examples: The experiment determined the exact value of the parameter.
The analysis identified three possible causes.
The researchers decided to repeat the experiment.

entries.legacy_meaning: 决定结果、条件或下一步行动

legacy_comparison.note: determine 可表示条件客观决定结果；decide 是人作决策；define 是明确范围、边界或内容。
examples: Budget constraints determine the project scope.
The steering committee decided to proceed.
The team defined the responsibilities of each role.

entries.legacy_meaning: 建立制度、团队、关系或业务

legacy_comparison.note: establish 较正式，强调建立并使之稳定；create 强调产生新的事物；set up 更口语，强调搭建或成立。
examples: The company established a new research group.
The partnership created new business opportunities.
We set up a temporary project team.

entries.legacy_meaning: 通过证据确立事实、关系或方法基础

legacy_comparison.note: establish 强调证据足以确立事实或关系；demonstrate 强调通过证据展示；show 是最一般的表明。
examples: The study established a causal relationship.
The experiment demonstrated the feasibility of the method.
The results show a clear improvement in accuracy.

entries.legacy_meaning: 评价方法、模型或研究结果

legacy_comparison.note: evaluate 是按标准综合评价；assess 是判断程度或状态；test 是通过实验或测试检验。
examples: We evaluated the model on three datasets.
We assessed the robustness of the method under noise.
We tested the model under low-light conditions.

entries.legacy_meaning: 评估方案、表现或选择

legacy_comparison.note: evaluate 是系统判断方案或表现；assess 强调风险或能力；compare 强调并列比较差异。
examples: The committee evaluated three proposals.
We assessed the financial risk of the project.
We compared the two suppliers on cost and quality.

entries.legacy_meaning: 扩大业务、团队、服务或市场

legacy_comparison.note: expand 强调扩大规模或范围；grow 多指自然或业务增长；extend 强调延长时间、距离或覆盖范围。
examples: The company expanded into Asia.
The business grew by 20% last year.

entries.legacy_meaning: 扩展模型、理论或研究范围

legacy_comparison.note: expand 强调扩大模型或分析内容；extend 强调把已有方法推广到新情形；broaden 强调拓宽研究范围。
examples: We expanded the analysis to a larger sample.
Future work could extend the method to moving targets.

entries.legacy_meaning: 集中注意力、资源或工作重点

legacy_comparison.note: focus on 是把注意力集中于某事；prioritize 是确定先后顺序；concentrate 更强调集中精力。
examples: We should focus on reliability.
We prioritized the safety issues first.

entries.legacy_meaning: 研究重点；把分析集中在某个问题上

legacy_comparison.note: focus on 表示研究重点；examine 强调仔细研究；address 强调处理一个研究问题。
examples: The paper focuses on indoor localization.
The study examines long-term stability.

entries.legacy_meaning: 识别变量、模式、原因或问题

legacy_comparison.note: identify 是识别出具体对象或原因；detect 是发现某物存在；determine 是进一步确定其性质、原因或数值。
examples: We identified three major sources of error.
The sensor detected an abnormal signal.
Further tests determined the exact cause of the failure.

entries.legacy_meaning: 找出风险、机会或责任人

legacy_comparison.note: identify 较正式，强调明确风险、机会或责任人；find 是一般找到；recognize 强调意识到或认出。
examples: We identified a major operational risk.
The team found a cheaper supplier.
The manager recognized the need for change.

entries.legacy_meaning: 表明、显示某种趋势或结论

legacy_comparison.note: indicate 表示数据表明某趋势；suggest 语气更谨慎；prove 表示证据足以证明，强度最高。
examples: The results indicate a small but consistent improvement.
The findings suggest that the effect may be temporary.
The theorem proves that the solution is unique.

entries.legacy_meaning: 显示、说明某种情况或方向

legacy_comparison.note: indicate 是较正式地表明；show 是一般展示或说明；signal 常指某迹象预示变化。
examples: The figures indicate a modest recovery.
The survey shows strong public support.
Falling demand may signal a slowdown.

entries.legacy_meaning: 涉及、包含某些人或任务

legacy_comparison.note: involve 表示某工作内在包含某任务或人员；include 是简单包含；engage 强调让某人积极参与。
examples: The role involves managing two teams.
The workshop engaged employees from every department.

entries.legacy_meaning: 研究过程包含某步骤、变量或参与者

legacy_comparison.note: involve 表示研究过程包含某步骤；include 只说明组成部分；require 强调必需条件。
examples: The method involves estimating two parameters.
The protocol requires three calibration measurements.

entries.legacy_meaning: 发生、出现某种现象或事件

legacy_comparison.note: occur 较正式，常用于现象发生；happen 更口语；arise 常指问题或情况逐渐出现。
examples: The error occurs at low signal levels.
A calibration problem arose during testing.

entries.legacy_meaning: 事件、事故或变化发生

legacy_comparison.note: occur 正式中性；happen 较口语；take place 常用于有计划的事件。
examples: The incident occurred after midnight.
The ceremony will take place on Friday.

entries.legacy_meaning: 获得数据、结果、许可或样本

legacy_comparison.note: obtain 是正式的“获得结果或数据”；acquire 强调获取过程；derive 强调从已有数据、公式或假设推导。
examples: We obtained similar results in all three experiments.
The receiver acquires measurements at ten hertz.
The parameter was derived from the observed data.

entries.legacy_meaning: 获得批准、信息或资源

legacy_comparison.note: obtain 是正式中性的“获得”；secure 强调经过努力成功取得；receive 强调被动收到。
examples: We obtained final approval last week.
The team secured additional funding for the project.
We received the signed contract this morning.

entries.legacy_meaning: 某任务、岗位或流程需要某条件

legacy_comparison.note: require 表示制度或岗位要求；need 是一般需要；request 是主动提出请求。
examples: The role requires strong analytical skills.
We need more time to complete the review.
The client requested a revised schedule.

entries.legacy_meaning: 方法、模型或实验需要特定数据或条件

legacy_comparison.note: require 表示方法或条件客观要求；need 是最普通的需要；demand 强调高强度要求或资源消耗。
examples: The method requires only two reference points.
The experiment needs additional calibration data.
Real-time processing demands substantial computing power.

entries.legacy_meaning: 回应消息、问题或他人的行为

legacy_comparison.note: respond 是一般回应；reply 更专指对话或消息的回复；react 强调对刺激产生情绪或行为反应。
examples: She responded to my message quickly.
He reacted angrily to the criticism.

entries.legacy_meaning: 身体或患者对治疗、药物或刺激产生反应

legacy_comparison.note: respond to treatment 指治疗产生效果；react to 强调身体对药物或刺激的反应；recover 是从疾病中恢复。
examples: The patient responded well to treatment.
She reacted badly to the medication.

entries.legacy_meaning: 允许某人做某事或允许某种安排

legacy_comparison.note: allow 是一般意义上的允许；permit 更正式，常用于制度、规则或授权；enable 强调创造条件或提供能力，使某事能够发生。
examples: The policy allows employees to work remotely.
The new rules permit staff to work from home two days a week.
Better tools enable the team to work faster.

entries.legacy_meaning: 使系统具备某种能力或访问权限

legacy_comparison.note: allow 表示允许某项操作或访问；enable 强调开启某项能力或功能；grant 强调正式授予权限。
examples: The firewall allows access from trusted networks.
This setting enables offline access.
The administrator granted the user access to the repository.

entries.legacy_meaning: 在数据、结果或现象中出现；看起来

legacy_comparison.note: appear to 表示看起来；seem 更一般；emerge 强调某种模式逐渐显现。
examples: The effect appears to be stronger at short range.
A clear pattern emerged from the data.

entries.legacy_meaning: 公开露面、出现或看起来具有某种状态

legacy_comparison.note: appear 是一般出现；emerge 强调逐渐出现；surface 常指新的信息或问题被发现。
examples: New details appeared in the report.
Fresh evidence surfaced during the investigation.

entries.legacy_meaning: 建立团队、能力、关系或业务基础

legacy_comparison.note: build 强调逐步建立能力、关系或团队；develop 强调发展；establish 强调正式建立。
examples: It takes time to build trust.
The company established a new research unit.

entries.legacy_meaning: 构建软件、系统或模型

legacy_comparison.note: build 常用于构建软件或系统；develop 强调开发过程；create 强调新建对象或资源。
examples: We built a prototype in two weeks.
Create a new project in the workspace.

entries.legacy_meaning: 原因；或导致某种结果

legacy_comparison.note: cause 直接表示导致；lead to 强调因果链条；result in 强调最终结果。
examples: High noise can cause estimation errors.
Poor calibration may lead to biased results.

entries.legacy_meaning: 导致症状、疾病或健康问题的因素

legacy_comparison.note: cause 表示直接导致；trigger 强调触发症状或事件；contribute to 表示只是众多原因之一。
examples: Lack of sleep can cause headaches.
Stress may trigger migraine symptoms.

entries.legacy_meaning: 沟通信息、想法或要求

legacy_comparison.note: communicate 强调双向传递信息；inform 强调告知；explain 强调说明原因或机制。
examples: Managers should communicate expectations clearly.
Please inform the team of the change.

entries.legacy_meaning: 与他人交流思想、感受或信息

legacy_comparison.note: communicate 是广义交流；talk 强调说话；interact 强调相互作用。
examples: They communicate mostly through messaging apps.
The children interacted naturally during the activity.

entries.legacy_meaning: 控制设备、系统或变量

legacy_comparison.note: control 强调直接控制系统行为；manage 强调整体管理；regulate 强调按规则调节。
examples: The software controls the motor speed.
The regulator manages power consumption automatically.

entries.legacy_meaning: 控制实验条件或干扰变量

legacy_comparison.note: control a variable 可指控制实验条件；hold constant 是保持不变；adjust for 是统计上校正。
examples: We controlled temperature during the experiment.
The model adjusted for age and prior experience.

entries.legacy_meaning: 创建产品、流程、机会或价值

legacy_comparison.note: create 强调产生新事物或价值；build 强调逐步建立；generate 常指产生结果、机会或数据。
examples: The partnership created new opportunities.
The campaign generated hundreds of leads.

entries.legacy_meaning: 新建文件、对象、账户或系统资源

legacy_comparison.note: create 常用于新建账户、文件或对象；build 常用于系统或软件；generate 常用于自动生成输出。
examples: Create a new account before signing in.
The tool generates a configuration file automatically.

entries.legacy_meaning: 开发软件、算法、系统或产品

legacy_comparison.note: develop 强调开发过程；build 强调把系统实现出来；design 强调设计结构和方案。
examples: The team developed a new algorithm.
The engineers designed the system architecture first.

entries.legacy_meaning: 逐渐出现疾病、症状或某种状态

legacy_comparison.note: develop a condition 表示逐渐出现疾病或症状；contract 更正式地指感染疾病；experience 强调感受到症状。
examples: He developed a fever overnight.
Some patients experienced mild dizziness.

entries.legacy_meaning: 通过研究发现事实、规律或现象

legacy_comparison.note: discover 强调首次发现新的事实；find 更一般；identify 强调明确识别出具体对象。
examples: Researchers discovered a new pattern.
The analysis identified three sources of error.

entries.legacy_meaning: 偶然发现某个地方、信息或事物

legacy_comparison.note: discover 常有“意外发现”的意味；find 是一般找到；notice 是注意到已存在的细节。
examples: We discovered a quiet café near the station.
I noticed a small mistake in the receipt.

entries.legacy_meaning: 启用功能；使系统能够完成某事

legacy_comparison.note: enable 是使功能可用；allow 是允许操作；activate 是把某功能或账户激活。
examples: The update enables offline access.
Activate the feature in settings.

entries.legacy_meaning: 创造条件使某人或团队能够完成任务

legacy_comparison.note: enable 强调提供条件或工具；empower 强调赋予人自主权和能力；allow 只是允许。
examples: Training enables staff to handle complex tasks.
The policy empowers managers to make local decisions.

entries.legacy_meaning: 确保某项要求、结果或流程得到满足

legacy_comparison.note: ensure 是正式地确保；make sure 更口语；guarantee 语气最强，暗示结果有保证。
examples: Please ensure that all fields are complete.
The warranty guarantees free repair for one year.

entries.legacy_meaning: 确保系统满足可靠性、安全或兼容要求

legacy_comparison.note: ensure 是通过措施确保结果；verify 是核实是否正确；validate 是确认是否符合要求。
examples: Redundancy helps ensure availability.
We verified the configuration before deployment.

entries.legacy_meaning: 解释现象、机制或研究结果

legacy_comparison.note: explain 强调说明为什么；describe 只是描述是什么；interpret 强调对结果赋予意义。
examples: The model explains the observed difference.
The paper describes the experimental setup in detail.

entries.legacy_meaning: 向他人说明决定、流程或问题原因

legacy_comparison.note: explain 是说明原因或过程；clarify 是把不清楚的地方说清；justify 是为决定提供理由。
examples: She explained the new process to the team.
The manager justified the budget increase with new data.

entries.legacy_meaning: 数量、成本、价格或收入增加

legacy_comparison.note: increase 可及物或不及物；rise 只表示自身上升；grow 常指较持续的增长。
examples: Revenue increased by 12%.
Operating costs rose sharply in Q2.

entries.legacy_meaning: 变量、性能或概率上升

legacy_comparison.note: increase 只表示数值变大；rise 是不及物上升；improve 表示变得更好，不等于数值变大。
examples: Error increases with distance.
Accuracy improved after calibration.

entries.legacy_meaning: 管理人员、项目、资源或风险

legacy_comparison.note: manage 强调管理资源和日常工作；lead 强调方向和领导；supervise 强调监督执行。
examples: She manages a team of twelve engineers.
He leads the product strategy.

entries.legacy_meaning: 设法完成某事或应付某种情况

legacy_comparison.note: manage to do 表示设法做到；cope 强调应付困难；handle 强调处理具体事务。
examples: I managed to finish before dinner.
She coped well with the sudden change.

entries.legacy_meaning: 提供服务、信息、资源或支持

legacy_comparison.note: provide 是通用的提供；offer 强调主动提出可供选择的东西；supply 多指持续供应物资。
examples: The supplier provides technical support.
The hotel offers free airport transport.

entries.legacy_meaning: 给出证据、数据、解释或方法

legacy_comparison.note: provide evidence/data 强调提供材料；show 强调结果表明；present 强调正式呈现。
examples: The experiment provides strong evidence.
The figure presents the results by age group.

entries.legacy_meaning: 降低成本、时间、风险或工作量

legacy_comparison.note: reduce 是正式中性的降低；cut 更直接，常指成本或数量削减；decrease 可及物或不及物，较书面。
examples: Automation reduced processing time.
The company cut travel costs by 20%.

entries.legacy_meaning: 降低症状、风险或暴露程度

legacy_comparison.note: reduce 是一般降低风险或症状；lower 常与数值指标搭配；relieve 强调缓解不适。
examples: Exercise reduces the risk of heart disease.
The medication relieved the pain quickly.

entries.legacy_meaning: 与某变量、理论或现象有关

legacy_comparison.note: relate to 是广义有关；associate with 表示存在关联；correlate with 特指统计相关。
examples: Performance is related to signal quality.
Error correlates with distance.

entries.legacy_meaning: 理解或认同他人的经历；与人建立共鸣

legacy_comparison.note: relate to 表示对他人经历有共鸣；connect 强调建立联系；empathize 强调理解他人感受。
examples: Many readers can relate to her experience.
She empathized with his frustration.

entries.legacy_meaning: 仍然处于某状态；问题仍未解决

legacy_comparison.note: remain 较正式，表示继续处于某状态；stay 更口语；persist 强调问题持续存在。
examples: The mechanism remains unclear.
The bias persisted after recalibration.

entries.legacy_meaning: 仍然存在或保持某种状况

legacy_comparison.note: remain 是正式的持续存在；stay 多用于具体状态或位置；continue 强调动作或状态延续。
examples: The restrictions remain in place.
The service will continue through winter.

entries.legacy_meaning: 表示某个变量、样本或概念

legacy_comparison.note: represent 表示某符号或样本代表某对象；indicate 是表明；depict 强调图像化描绘。
examples: Each point represents one measurement.
The diagram depicts the system architecture.

entries.legacy_meaning: 代表某群体、机构或利益

legacy_comparison.note: represent 是正式代表某群体；speak for 强调替某人发言；stand for 可指象征或支持某立场。
examples: She represents the district in parliament.
The organization speaks for small businesses.

entries.legacy_meaning: 支持团队、客户、决定或工作推进

legacy_comparison.note: support 是持续帮助或资源支持；assist 更偏具体帮助；back 强调公开支持某决定或人。
examples: The operations team supports three business units.
The board backed the proposal unanimously.

entries.legacy_meaning: 证据支持某个主张、假设或解释

legacy_comparison.note: support 表示证据与主张一致；confirm 表示进一步印证；prove 强度最高，表示足以证明。
examples: The data support the main hypothesis.
A second experiment confirmed the pattern.

entries.legacy_meaning: 转账、转移资金或资产

legacy_comparison.note: transfer 是资金在账户间转移；send 是一般发送；remit 是较正式的汇款。
examples: I transferred the money to my savings account.
The company remitted payment to the supplier.

entries.legacy_meaning: 传输数据、文件或知识模型

legacy_comparison.note: transfer 是广义传输或转移；transmit 强调信号或数据发送；move 强调改变文件位置。
examples: The system transfers data securely.
The sensor transmits a packet every second.

entries.legacy_meaning: 验证身份、数据、配置或结果是否正确

legacy_comparison.note: verify 是核实是否正确；validate 是确认是否符合要求；check 是最普通的检查。
examples: We verified the configuration before deployment.
The form validates the input automatically.

entries.legacy_meaning: 通过分析或实验验证结果或假设

legacy_comparison.note: verify 是通过实验核实；confirm 是进一步支持已有结论；replicate 是重复研究看结果能否再现。
examples: We verified the result with an independent dataset.
Another lab replicated the experiment successfully.

entries.legacy_meaning: 改善绩效、流程、服务或能力

legacy_comparison.note: improve 是一般变好；enhance 强调增强已有质量或能力；optimize 强调在约束下调到最佳。
examples: The new workflow improved efficiency.
We optimized the process for lower cost.

entries.legacy_meaning: 提高模型、方法或测量性能

legacy_comparison.note: improve 表示性能变好；increase 只表示数值变大；enhance 强调增强某项性质。
examples: Calibration improved accuracy.
More antennas increased the signal power.

entries.legacy_meaning: 持续监测系统、设备或指标状态

legacy_comparison.note: monitor 强调持续监测状态；observe 是一般观察；track 强调随时间记录变化。
examples: We monitor network latency continuously.
The dashboard tracks daily error rates.

entries.legacy_meaning: 持续观察症状、生命体征或健康变化

legacy_comparison.note: monitor 强调持续观察健康指标；check 是一次性检查；track 强调长期记录趋势。
examples: Patients should monitor their blood pressure.
The app tracks heart rate over time.

entries.legacy_meaning: 认出某人、某物或理解某种情绪

legacy_comparison.note: recognize 是认出熟悉对象；identify 是确定身份；notice 是注意到变化或细节。
examples: I recognized him from the photo.
She noticed a change in his tone.

entries.legacy_meaning: 正式承认某种身份、地位或事实

legacy_comparison.note: recognize 是正式承认身份、权利或事实；acknowledge 是承认某事实存在；accept 是接受观点或决定。
examples: The law recognizes the right to appeal.
The report acknowledges several limitations.

entries.legacy_meaning: 发布软件、版本或功能

legacy_comparison.note: release 是发布某个版本；launch 多指首次推出产品；deploy 是把系统部署到运行环境。
examples: The team released version 2.0.
We deployed the update to production that night.

entries.legacy_meaning: 公开发布报告、数据或信息

legacy_comparison.note: release 强调把信息对外公开；publish 强调正式出版或发布文档；announce 强调公布消息。
examples: The agency released the report on Friday.
The journal published the study online.

entries.legacy_meaning: 从多个候选中选择人员、方案或供应商

legacy_comparison.note: select 比 choose 更正式，强调从候选中挑选；appoint 是正式任命某人担任职位。
examples: The panel selected three candidates.
The board appointed her as chair.

entries.legacy_meaning: 选择样本、变量、特征或方法

legacy_comparison.note: select 是从集合中选择对象；sample 是按抽样方法选取样本；choose 是一般选择。
examples: We selected the variables before modeling.
We sampled 200 participants from the registry.

entries.legacy_meaning: 解决问题、冲突或业务难题

legacy_comparison.note: solve 常与 problem 搭配；resolve 常与 issue/conflict 搭配；fix 更口语，常指具体故障。
examples: We solved the scheduling problem.
The team resolved the customer complaint.

entries.legacy_meaning: 求解方程、优化问题或研究问题

legacy_comparison.note: solve 是求解问题或方程；derive 是推导公式或结果；compute 是计算数值。
examples: We solved the equations numerically.
The closed-form expression was derived analytically.
